height_formula: Supplied pressurepath sea-level altitude; missing values use tag pressure, ERA5 surface pressure/temperature/elevation and -6.5 K/km; subtract path2elevation Copernicus GLO-90 cell median (scale=4, sampling_scale=4), interpolated by fractional stap_id; negative flight heights binned at zero
flight_filter: All classified flight; tags without usable flight pressurepaths excluded
time_weighting: Interval to next retained tag record capped at 60 min; final record uses median positive interval
